name: 8ttech
problem: Many factories in Vietnam still rely on manual visual inspection, resulting in low defect-sorting accuracy and heavy dependence on inspection staff.
value_summary: 8ttech provides an AI vision-based automatic sorting solution that detects even micro-defects in real time and can be applied to production lines without disruption.
vietnam_fit: Aligned with the Vietnamese government's SMEdx smart-manufacturing transition support policy, contributing to workforce reallocation and productivity gains.
target_buyer_display: Seeking partnerships with major manufacturers and industrial park management boards. Matching inquiries via KICC HCMC.
